newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY MKT RATES UNCHANGED IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY MKT RATES UNCHANGED IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: Short term trading rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted stable at Wednesday's levels despite a rise in the level of liquidity on Thursday, dealers said.
"Today there's not much happening and it looks like rates are very stable at the moment," commented one dealer.
He said discount houses were taking up 91-day treasury bills at 19.36 percent while 30, 60 and 90-day NCDs held steady at 19.75 percent.
Bankers acceptances with maturity of 30 days were also unchanged at 19.50 percent as were the 60 and 90-day bills at 19.75 percent.
Call money was at 19 percent with Reserve Bank figures indicating a pre-settlement market surplus of Z$158 million, up from Z$97 million on Wednesday.
